We have effective treatment for ankylosing spondylitis.  If you come in the beginning it may take less time, we can cure it in 3 to 4 weeks. Normally the pain and stiffness comes down in a week, the patients will get relief day by day.  Duration of the treatment depends on the severity, how long the patient is suffering from, where ever it is affected etc… If it affects only on spine, it may take comparatively less time than a patient is badly affected in the hip as well.  If you can’t sit, stand, lay down and walk properly, it may take comparatively more time. Normally we admit the patients for one to two months, rare cases it may take some more time.  If the patient is bedridden, we can’t say anything about the duration and result.   It is better you come at the earliest. Treatments for ankylosing spondilitis are taking comparatively more time than cervical or lumbar spondylosis.  It is difficult to say the exact duration of the treatment.

Our ankylosing spondylitis treatment includes  Panchakarma treatments like Abhyangam (massage) with specially prepared Ayurvedic oil, Elakizhi, Njavarakizhi, Snehanam, Swedanam (medicated steam bath),Vamanam, Virechana etc.. as per the requirement.  In addition we apply specially prepared herbal paste (lepam), for external application in the affected areas, internal medication (prepared out of rare herbal combinations) etc… according to the patient’s medical condition

Even if a patient is not responding to pain killers, our treatment will be effective.  Normally the patient will get at least 80% relief. If a patient is under other medications for a long time, they may have other problems due to the side effects of steroids and other medicines that they have taken earlier.  Normally Amkylosing spondylitis patients may have problems like high blood pressure, high pulse rate, gastric problems, acidity etc…  We will treat and cure such diseases as well, in such cases it is taking comparatively more time.   We will remove stiffness, bulging, swelling etc… and the patient regains flexibility and mobility. It helps in prevening further degeneration.  It is better to start the treatment at the earliest. You have to continue the medication for at least  one year, duration depends on how fast the patient is recovering.

We are using pure Ayurvedic/herbal/natural medicines for the treatment of Ankylosing spondylitis, which are free from side effects, at the same time our treatment helps you to remove the side effects of medicines that you have taken earlier.

In case of Cervical or Lumbar spondylosis it is normally taking 3 weeks to cure it   In case of ankylosing spondylitis normally it is taking one to three months time to remove the stiffness, swelling and pain.    In acute cases sometimes it may take more time, that we can’t say in advance.  If you are able to walk and sit for long time, it may take comparatively less time, if the patient is unable to walk, sit and lay down properly for long time, in such cases it may take comparatively more time, Patients slowly regains flexibility and mobility.  In severe/acute cases  we can’t say anything in advance, there is chance for slow recovery.

What is Ankylosing spondylitis

Ankylosing spondylitis is a type of arthritis, which mainly affects the joints of the spine, sacroiliac joints and pelvis.  There will be pain and stiffness, sometimes the vertebrae may fuse together, resulting in rigid spine. There will be swelling, stiffness, bulging,  pain etc..  .  Symptoms include Neck pain, back pain stiffness, swelling etc…     Spondylosis is a degenerative disease of the spine.  There will be pain, swelling, bulging, narrowing, sometimes nerve compression, disk herniation, numbness  etc…

We are treating Ankylosing spondylitis for generations, we have very good experience in treating spobdylitis.   What ever may be your condition, if you comes to us we will try our best to  cure you, and  we will do it in the shortest time possible.
